ETH.note: The AI system is in agriculture, which this study excludes.

facts.fact: CGIAR reports that the HaFAS fertilizer advisory system, run by Ethiopia's Ministry of Agriculture and EIAR and using AI and machine learning analytics, gave farm-specific recommendations to 49,000 farmers in 2025 and is being adopted in the national extension system.
CGIAR reports that HaFAS raised wheat yields by 16-25 percent and maize yields by 10.5-17.6 percent among participating farmers in 2025, and cut input costs by 20 percent.

ETH.note: Does not say a model was built or hosted in Ethiopia; a soil database is not made for AI.
